meta.title: AI Agent for Revit & Archicad
meta.description: Download Architecton, the MoE-powered AI agent that reads, creates, and coordinates BIM models in Revit and Archicad.
meta.ogTitle: Architecton - AI Agent for Revit & Archicad
meta.ogDescription: Read complete BIM models, create native elements, and coordinate multi-storey designs through specialized AI experts.

hero.title:
Architecton for
Revit & Archicad
hero.description: Powered by a Mixture-of-Experts, Architecton reads your BIM model, creates native elements, and applies only approved changes—all through one chat.
hero.availability: Version-specific builds for Revit and Archicad
hero.imageAlt: Architectural BIM model with Architecton active inside the authoring workflow

integrations.title: Choose Revit or Archicad.
integrations.description: Select the BIM application you use. On the next page, you can choose the matching host version and review its installer status and requirements.
integrations.note: Host versions and installer status are shown after you select a platform.

building.title: Watch a brief become a coordinated BIM model.
building.description: Scroll to follow Architecton as it interprets the request, organizes the spaces, and assembles a reviewable two-storey house inside the BIM workflow.

chat.request: Create a small 6 m × 6 m, two-storey house. Add exterior and interior walls, floors, windows, a door, and a roof.
chat.disclaimer: Architecton can make mistakes. Review changes before applying them.

steps.plan: Set out the footprint and base
steps.complete: Install openings and finish the roof

status.plan: Creating the site base and ground slab
status.ground: Placing the ground-storey walls one by one
status.upper: Adding the intermediate slab and upper-storey walls
status.complete: Installing windows, door, and four-sided roof

features.title: From one prompt to a complete, editable building.
features.description: Architecton turns a design brief into coordinated native geometry, then keeps developing the same project as requirements change.

building.title: Generate complete multi-storey buildings
building.description: Describe the building type, levels, rooms, circulation, and design constraints. Architecton develops them into one coordinated, editable model.

create.title: Create native architectural elements
create.description: Build walls, floors, roofs, doors, windows, rooms, stairs, and levels directly in Revit or Archicad.

revise.title: Develop and revise the design
revise.description: Change layouts, dimensions, elements, or parameters through follow-up prompts while preserving the project context.

experts.title: Coordinate the building as one system
experts.description: Bring spatial planning, form, circulation, project rules, and technical constraints into one consistent design.

read.title: Work from the active project
read.description: Use existing levels, elements, parameters, quantities, and relationships as the starting point for every request.

workflow.title: From installation to a building—through one chat.
workflow.description: Like an AI coding assistant inside an editor, Architecton works inside your design tool. You describe the result; it understands the active project and helps build it.

install.title: Install Architecton
install.description: Choose Revit or Archicad, install the integration, and sign in once.

chat.title: Open the chat
chat.description: Architecton opens directly beside the project you are already working on.

prompt.title: Describe what you need
prompt.description: Write a clear request in everyday language—from one change to an entire building.

understand.title: Architecton understands the project
understand.description: It reads the active model and coordinates the right specialized agents around your request.

approve.title: Review and approve
approve.description: You remain in control and confirm the proposed work before it changes the project.

building.title: Continue with the building
building.description: Native, editable elements are created in Revit or Archicad, ready for your next prompt.

canvas.result: Editable building in your design tool

cta.eyebrow: A new class of BIM authoring
cta.title:
From prompt to
coordinated architecture.
cta.description: Move beyond generic AI assistants and disconnected automation tools. Architecton combines model intelligence, specialized design experts, and native BIM execution in one focused workflow.

spatial.title: Spatial intelligence
spatial.description: Experts reason about levels, rooms, circulation, relationships, and the way spaces work together.

systems.title: Form and building systems
systems.description: Experts coordinate geometry with walls, openings, floors, roofs, and other native BIM elements.

rules.title: Rules and model logic
rules.description: Experts evaluate project constraints and BIM structure, then return a coordinated plan for your approval.

footer.description: MoE-powered AI agents for reading, creating, and coordinating BIM models.
